name: AudioCaps: Generating Captions for Audios in The Wild
description: AudioCaps is an audio captioning benchmark dataset consisting of 51,308 audio clips from AudioSet paired with 57,188 human-written natural language captions. Introduced at NAACL-HLT 2019, it serves as the premier standard for training and evaluating automated audio captioning, sound event retrieval, and multimodal audio-language foundation models.
